title: BC issue with sortBy "isRefined"
body:
I have implementations where:

`sortBy: 'isRefined'`

Previously this would make active refinements go to the top of the list.

Now this is no longer the case and I have to use `sortBy: 'isRefined:desc'`

Any clue on this?

comments.body: This feature relies on the Helper. I opened an issue [there](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/issues/354).
The regression has been introduced with 1.8.
This is fixed in 2.13.0 of the helper.
